title: Man kills wife, six of her family members; dumps bodies across Bengaluru
content: Indushekar is accused of murdering his wife, Divya, along with six of her family members. The murders allegedly occurred over several days due to ongoing disputes between Indushekar and Divya. After Divya reported her family missing, she was reportedly killed by Indushekar. Police are currently investigating the case and gathering further details surrounding the murders. The community is in shock as they learn about this tragic event that unfolded.

title: Mini Cooper was travelling at 162kmph before Kochi crash, BMW report confirms
content: A tragic accident occurred near Nedumbassery when a Mini Cooper, confirmed to be speeding by BMW, collided with a scooter, resulting in the death of three young men. Reports indicate the vehicle was traveling at 162 kmph before impact and 144 kmph at the moment of collision. The driver, Suhail Sajeev, may have been under the influence of alcohol and applied the brakes mere seconds before the crash.

title: California’s billionaire tax faces defeat, but tech execs may not be off the hook
content: In a notable decision, California voters have turned down Proposition 40, which aimed to implement a wealth tax on billionaires. Conversely, Propositions 41 and 42 have gained majority favor. Advocates plan to reintroduce the measure in 2028 while other states like Washington and Colorado are exploring similar tax options for high earners. Meanwhile, there is anticipation of federal tax hikes targeting wealthy individuals and corporations to support middle-class initiatives.

title: ‘Too early for him’: Sachin's blunt verdict on Sooryavanshi’s leadership role
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has achieved a significant milestone by being appointed as the East Zone vice-captain for the Duleep Trophy, a testament to his talent. However, cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar has voiced reservations about Sooryavanshi taking on such a crucial leadership role at a young age. With only eight red-ball matches under his belt, Tendulkar advised him to gather more experience before stepping into the spotlight.

title: Wendy's rejects $1.4bn Peltz takeover bid, adopts poison pill defence
content: Wendy's has rejected a takeover proposal valued at $1.4 billion from billionaire investor Nelson Peltz. The fast-food chain argued that the offer undervalues its long-term growth potential, prompting the adoption of a shareholder rights plan. This defensive strategy is designed to protect the company from unwanted acquisition attempts. Wendy's has been facing declining sales and rising operational costs in the competitive fast-food market.

title: 3 criminals killed in police encounter near Ganga in Patna, SHO injured

Maner Station House Officer Rajnish Kumar was injured by gunfire but is receiving treatment. The Patna Special Task Force and local police coordinated their efforts after receiving intelligence about a potential crime. Authorities also recovered firearms from the deceased individuals, all of whom had prior criminal histories.

title: Khamenei's 7 demands - what was discussed in Putin-Iran security chief meeting
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin met Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei in Moscow, where he received a letter from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei amid diplomatic efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran. The talks covered post-war regional security, energy cooperation and a proposed gas pipeline between the two countries. Rezaei said Tehran would neither negotiate with Washington nor reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the US meets its seven demands. The meeting comes as Russia reiterates its willingness to support efforts to end the conflict.

title: Philippine village uses bamboo and oyster shells to stop floods for two years
content: Pamarawan village in the Philippines has embraced an innovative coastal defense system to tackle flooding challenges. This initiative incorporates natural materials such as bamboo poles, oyster shells, and coconut husks to fortify against powerful waves and prevent sediment displacement. Remarkably, there have been no flooding incidents reported for almost two years since the project's inception, prompting officials to explore similar setups for other flood-threatened areas.

title: Zomato founder to doctors: I see your rage against Temple, I have few points

Goyal stated the product offers a 14-day return policy for customer satisfaction. Additionally, he mentioned plans to publish scientific validation for the device in due course. Lastly, he assured confidence in the innovative features that Temple brings to the wellness market.

title: Waitlisted tickets, late confirmation: Kerala man wins Rs 19,700 from Railway
content: A consumer commission in Kerala ruled that Southern Railway must refund Rs 6,700 to a passenger. The commission concluded that late confirmation of train tickets caused financial loss to the complainant. The complainant booked tickets on May 24, 2018, for travel on June 22, 2018, but received confirmation less than four hours before departure. The commission ordered additional compensation for mental anguish and litigation expenses.

Several areas, including IIT Delhi and Rohini, reported even worse levels in the 'severe' category. title: 'Rahul's offer to debate still stands': Tharoor challenges BJP amid SIR row
content: "if Parliament reconvene, I believe Rahul Gandhi's offer to debate still stands," Tharoor says . he also criticizes the Election Commissiono ver's handling of the SIR . the election commissiono ver alleges procedural irregularities .

title: 'No impact on India-US ties': Tharoor says Trump retains power on tariffs, Iran war
content: the results of the midterm elections would have little impact on India-US relations . he said the election results would not change Washington's approach to key issues . the election result would not affect the country's foreign policy agenda, he says .

title: Trump-Kim reset after midterm blow? Why North Korea may hold the cards
content: a Reuters report says president obama may seek a breakthrough with north Korea . the wars in Ukraine and Iran are yet to produce diplomatic breakthroughs, analysts say . analysts say the region has little reason to return to the negotiating table at present .

title: At 93, the battles of Tokyo still live on in Dharam Singh Mann's memory
content: dharam Singh Mann played in the gold-medal-winning team at the 1964 Tokyo Olympics and the bronze-winning side at the 1968 Mexico Games . he remembers the bruises, battles and bonds that shaped his journey . "the day I got my first chance, there was no looking back," he says .

title: 'Nobody can touch it': Trump order bars future prezs from changing Oval Office decor
content: presidents have considerable authority to make changes to the Oval Office . the order declares the office a national monument and places it under the management of the national park service . it does not prevent the president from redecorating the office, changing its furniture .

title: 'Jantar Mantar in Kochi': Actor Prakash Raj calls for anti-SIR protest on Saturday
content: actor appeals to students, young people, civil society members and representatives of various organisations to participate in the demonstration . he said citizens must come together to “save our democracy” in a video message on X . the actor called on people to join the protest peacefully .

title: Praful Patel visits Sharad Pawar in hospital amid reported discontent with Sunetra
content: patel said the veteran politician was stable and expected to return home in a day or two . the visit by patel has triggered political speculation as he is among the NCP leaders reportedly "unhappy" with party boss Sunetra Pawar's leadership .

title: 30 aircraft, 8 countries: How bomb threats disrupted flights across Europe
content: a flight from Dublin to Rome was diverted to france amid reports of bomb threats . the latest wave marks a significant escalation from Tuesday . at least seven flights and a cruise ship received similar threats across Europe .

title: Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam move Supreme Court for bail
content: the accused submitted that two co-accused, including Tasleem Ahmed, were granted bail by SC on the grou-nd that determination of the issues by the larger bench would take time . they could not be made to suffer continued incarceration . former student activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam have moved for bail in 2020 riots cases .

title: Jyot Singh scripts history, becomes first Sikh elected to Georgia Assembly
content: a Democrat and Yale University alumnus, Jyot Singh won the election to represent Georgia House district 97 . he became the first Sikh and Indian-American to serve in the state's general Assembly . Singh secured 13,820 votes, accounting for 68 per cent of the total .

title: Denzel Washington helped save playwright's childhood home with $5m restoration
content: the property where August Wilson spent his formative years has been transformed into a 6,000-square-foot arts and community centre . the restoration, supported by a fundraising campaign led by Hollywood actor Denzel Washington, has given the building a renewed purpose while preserving the surroundings that influenced Wilson's celebrated body of work .

title: 'Long road ahead': Eisenkot beats Netanyahu 67-46 in backing but govt test looms
content: Gadi Eisenkot received recommendations from more than 61 lawmakers required for a majority . he has secured the backing of 67 members of the Knesset to form the government . this has also put him ahead of prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu .

title: LAL salaam: Two largest US cities now run by PIOs
content: the early primary election returns had placed her third in the race for mayor, behind incumbent Karen Bass and reality tv personality Spencer Pratt . her father, an IITian, comforted campaign workers, telling them her full name Nithya Varsha means 'everlasting monsoon'

title: 1 officer killed, 3 injured as gunman opens fire on police in Colorado
content: one officer was killed and three others wounded in a firefight with a suspect in Lakewood, a suburb of Denver, on Thursday evening . the shootout took place after police responded to a report of a suspicious person attempting to board a public bus .

title: 'He's done a fantastic job': Trump backs Hegseth amid growing calls for his removal
content: president Donald Trump has defended secretary of war Pete Hegseth amid calls for his resignation and impeachment . he said the defence chief had performed a "fantastic job" the president also sought to defend his administration's military rectory .
